msg: New request from the operator: "Let adults take larger meal boluses"
title: Let adults take larger meal boluses

msg: Recalled 1 items from local (tickets, meetings, chats, emails, code)

memory.title: #pump-firmware Slack thread
memory.text: Product asked for bigger meal boluses for adult users with high insulin needs (carb ratio 5). Firmware lead: OK only if per-hour delivery stays within the max bolus rate and the daily cap of 60 U still applies.

msg: Hazard analysis: mapping the request to hazards and requirements

In scope: H-1, H-2, H-3 (SR-1, SR-2, SR-3). Raising the size of a meal bolus can break the 10 U single-bolus cap (SR-1) or use up the 60 U daily cap early, which can cause severe hypoglycemia, especially when BG is already low or near 70 mg/dL.

analysis.risk: Raising the size of a meal bolus can break the 10 U single-bolus cap (SR-1) or use up the 60 U daily cap early, which can cause severe hypoglycemia, especially when BG is already low or near 70 mg/dL.
analysis.guidance: Do not change MAX_BOLUS_U, MAX_DAILY_U or MIN_BG_FOR_BOLUS; deliver a large meal dose through the existing extended-bolus interface as parts of 10 U or less, add a per-hour delivery limit, and before each part check the BG gate, the daily total (delivered_today_u) and the hourly limit so that SR-1, SR-2 and SR-3 still pass.
analysis.new_hazard: Bolus stacking: back-to-back or extended bolus parts inside one hour can go over the maximum hourly delivery rate, and the log has no per-hour limit for this; a related risk is that a non-adult profile gets adult-sized meal doses.
